_comment: Figma's product surface as of Config 2026, used to judge whether a post's use case is something Figma could DISPLACE. A post qualifies as a lead source only if the solution the poster is offering maps to one of these surfaces. Sources: figma.com/blog/config-2026-recap, help.figma.com What's new from Config 2026, figma.com product pages.

design.what: Core UI/UX product design: web & mobile interfaces, components, design systems, variables, auto layout, prototyping.

make.what: AI prompt-to-product: generate functional, interactive web/mobile apps and landing pages from text prompts.
use_cases: build an app from a prompt
displaces: Claude / Claude Code for app building

sites.what: Design and publish websites with no code, including CMS.

slides.what: Presentation tool built for designers: live collaborative decks, clickable prototypes in slides, design reviews.

figjam.what: Online whiteboard for diagrams, flowcharts, brainstorms, planning, workshops, research, journey maps.

dev_mode.what: Design-to-code handoff: inspect designs, extract code-ready assets, Code Layers (clone repos into Figma, real code on canvas, AI code gen, sync back to source).

draw.what: Illustration and expressive vector editing: brushes, transforms, textures, shaders, 3D transforms.

buzz.what: AI-enhanced, on-brand marketing content/asset creation at scale for brands.
displaces: AI image tools for brand assets

motion.what: Figma Motion: animation on the canvas -- timeline, keyframes, presets, AI-generated motion; export to CSS/React/MP4/WebM/SVG/GIF; 3D transforms. Pitch: no After Effects, no tool switching for UI animation.
use_cases: get off After Effects for UI

agent.what: Config-2026 Figma Agent + Agent Skills + connectors: automate design-workflow glue -- keep Figma in sync with Notion/Jira/Slack, generate/maintain design-system docs, run reusable AI workflows, no manual busywork.
use_cases: keep Figma and Notion/Jira in sync

not_figma: general business / marketing / sales coaching with no design tool
data engineering, code review, refactoring, test automation (pure software engineering)
photo retouching as an end in itself (raster photo editing)
